title: xyz_3_del_damp_theta_phi
description: `xyz_3_del_damp_theta_phi` calculates delay time, damping, and directional angles for the direct sound and early reflections in a rectangular room simulation. Configure it with room, source, and listener coordinates in metres, plus sonic speed and a minimum radius; its output can be routed by reflection group (`direct`, `early1`, etc.) and parameter (`del`, `damp`, `theta`, or `phi`).
